fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: Your passport must be valid at least 6 months after arrival and have at least 2 blank pages.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe tener al menos 6 meses de validez tras la llegada y al menos 2 páginas en blanco.
entry.quote: your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive and have at least 2 blank pages.

entry.en: Foreign nationals arriving in India must complete an e-arrival card online before reaching immigration.
entry.es: Los extranjeros que llegan a India deben completar una tarjeta de llegada electrónica en línea antes de pasar por inmigración.
entry.quote: Foreign nationals arriving in India must complete an e-arrival card online before reaching immigration.

entry.en: The online e-arrival card can be completed up to 72 hours before arrival.
entry.es: La tarjeta de llegada electrónica se puede completar hasta 72 horas antes de la llegada.
entry.quote: The online e-arrival card can be completed up to 72 hours before you arrive.

entry.en: You must declare cash above 5,000 US dollars in notes, or above 10,000 US dollars in notes and travellers cheques combined.
entry.es: Debes declarar más de 5.000 dólares en billetes, o más de 10.000 dólares entre billetes y cheques de viaje.
entry.quote: You must declare any amount above 5,000 US dollars in notes, or 10,000 US dollars in notes and travellers cheques combined.

entry.en: It is illegal to overstay your visa in India.
entry.es: Es ilegal quedarse en India más allá de la vigencia de la visa.
entry.quote: It’s illegal to overstay your visa in India.

safety.en: The FCDO says terrorists are very likely to try to carry out attacks in India.
safety.es: El FCDO indica que es muy probable que los terroristas intenten cometer atentados en India.
safety.quote: Terrorists are very likely to try to carry out attacks in India.

safety.en: Scammers, pickpockets and ticket touts target foreign nationals in tourist areas.
safety.es: Estafadores, carteristas y revendedores de entradas se dirigen a los extranjeros en zonas turísticas.
safety.quote: Be cautious in tourist areas, where scammers, pickpockets and ticket touts target foreign nationals.

safety.en: Female travellers often experience verbal and physical harassment by individuals or groups of men.
safety.es: Las viajeras suelen sufrir acoso verbal y físico por parte de hombres, solos o en grupo.
safety.quote: Female travellers often experience verbal and physical harassment by individuals or groups of men.

safety.en: The FCDO advises against all travel to the Union Territory of Jammu and Kashmir, with limited exceptions for Jammu city.
safety.es: El FCDO desaconseja todo viaje al Territorio de la Unión de Jammu y Cachemira, con excepciones limitadas en la ciudad de Jammu.
safety.quote: FCDO advises against all travel to the Union Territory of Jammu and Kashmir

safety.en: India has a high death rate from road accidents.
safety.es: India tiene una alta tasa de muertes por accidentes de tráfico.
safety.quote: India has a high death rate from road accidents.

safety.en: Strikes, political rallies and demonstrations happen frequently and can become violent.
safety.es: Las huelgas, mítines políticos y manifestaciones ocurren con frecuencia y pueden volverse violentos.
safety.quote: Strikes (sometimes referred to as ‘bandh’ or ‘hartal’), political rallies and demonstrations happen frequently and can become violent.

health.en: To get an ambulance in India, dial 112.
health.es: Para pedir una ambulancia en India, marca el 112.
health.quote: Dial 112 and ask for an ambulance.

health.en: Medical facilities differ from those in the UK, especially in more remote areas.
health.es: Los centros médicos difieren de los del Reino Unido, sobre todo en zonas remotas.
health.quote: Medical facilities differ from those in the UK, especially in more remote areas.

health.en: Severe air pollution is a major health hazard, especially in the winter months from October to February.
health.es: La contaminación atmosférica grave es un riesgo importante para la salud, sobre todo de octubre a febrero.
health.quote: Severe air pollution is a major health hazard, especially during the winter months from October to February.

health.en: Tap water is normally not safe for drinking, nor for brushing teeth for most foreigners.
health.es: El agua del grifo normalmente no es segura para beber ni para cepillarse los dientes para la mayoría de extranjeros.
health.quote: Tap water is normally not safe for drinking, and it is not even safe to brush your teeth with tap water for most foreigners.

health.en: Pharmacies are widely available in India.
health.quote: Pharmacies are widely available  in India.

health.en: Wikivoyage says private hospitals are usually of an excellent standard.
health.es: Wikivoyage indica que los hospitales privados suelen tener un nivel excelente.
health.quote: Private hospitals, on the other hand, are usually of an excellent standard

help.en: The emergency number for ambulance, fire and police is 112.
help.es: El número de emergencias para ambulancia, bomberos y policía es el 112.

help.en: The 112 emergency service provides support in English, Hindi and additional languages.
help.es: El servicio de emergencias 112 ofrece atención en inglés, hindi y otros idiomas.
help.quote: These services provide support in English, Hindi and additional languages.

help.en: The Indian Ministry of Tourism helpline is 1800 11 1363.
help.es: La línea de ayuda del Ministerio de Turismo de India es el 1800 11 1363.
help.quote: Indian Ministry of Tourism helpline Telephone: 1800 11 1363

help.en: Cybercrime can be reported on the National Cybercrime Helpline by dialling 1930.
help.es: El cibercrimen se puede denunciar en la línea nacional de cibercrimen marcando el 1930.

getting_in.en: The major points of entry are Delhi, Mumbai and Bengaluru airports.
getting_in.es: Los principales puntos de entrada son los aeropuertos de Delhi, Bombay y Bangalore.
getting_in.quote: The major points of entry are Delhi (DEL IATA), Mumbai (BOM IATA) and Bengaluru (BLR IATA).

getting_in.en: You must carry a valid air ticket or boarding pass, as it will be checked on arrival in India.
getting_in.es: Debes llevar un billete de avión o tarjeta de embarque válido, que se revisará al llegar a India.
getting_in.quote: You must carry either a valid air ticket (electronic or printed) or valid boarding pass, as it will be checked on arrival in India.

getting_in.en: The only scheduled international passenger service by sea is the Nagapattinam–Kankesanthurai ferry between Tamil Nadu and northern Sri Lanka.
getting_in.es: El único servicio marítimo internacional regular de pasajeros es el ferri Nagapattinam–Kankesanthurai entre Tamil Nadu y el norte de Sri Lanka.
getting_in.quote: The only scheduled international passenger service is the Nagapattinam–Kankesanthurai ferry between Tamil Nadu and northern Sri Lanka

getting_in.en: Overland travel into India is extremely limited due to tensions with Pakistan and China.
getting_in.es: El viaje terrestre a India es muy limitado por las tensiones con Pakistán y China.
getting_in.quote: Overland travel is extremely limited in India due to tensions with Pakistan and China

getting_in.en: There are no longer any visa-on-arrival facilities in India.
getting_in.es: Ya no hay visa a la llegada en India.
getting_in.quote: there are no longer any visa-on-arrival facilities in India.

getting_around.en: Rapido, Ola and Uber operate ride-hailing in all major Indian cities and have ranks at major airports.
getting_around.es: Rapido, Ola y Uber ofrecen transporte por aplicación en todas las grandes ciudades y tienen puntos en los principales aeropuertos.
getting_around.quote: Rapido, Ola and Uber, which operate in all major Indian cities and have ranks at major airports.

getting_around.en: Metro services are available in most major cities and are relatively safe and well policed.
getting_around.es: Hay metro en la mayoría de las grandes ciudades, con seguridad y vigilancia relativamente buenas.
getting_around.quote: Metro services are available in most major cities, relatively safe and well policed

getting_around.en: Auto-rickshaws are the most common means of hired transport in India.
getting_around.es: Los autorickshaws son el medio de transporte contratado más común en India.
getting_around.quote: Auto-rickshaws or autos are the most common means of hired transport in India.

getting_around.en: India drives on the left, at least most of the time.
getting_around.es: En India se conduce por la izquierda, al menos la mayor parte del tiempo.
getting_around.quote: Unlike parts of Asia, India drives on the left

getting_around.en: You need an IRCTC account to book train tickets online.
getting_around.es: Necesitas una cuenta de IRCTC para reservar billetes de tren en línea.
getting_around.quote: you will need an IRCTC account if you want to book online.

getting_around.en: Regular metered taxis are common and can usually be hailed on the street.
getting_around.es: Los taxis con taxímetro son comunes y normalmente se pueden parar en la calle.
getting_around.quote: Regular metered taxis are common and can usually be hailed on the street.

money.en: The currency in India is the Indian rupee (INR).
money.es: La moneda de India es la rupia india (INR).
money.quote: The currency in India is the Indian rupee (sign: ₹; code: INR).

money.en: Small businesses and family-run stores almost never accept credit cards, so keeping some cash is useful.
money.es: Los pequeños negocios y tiendas familiares casi nunca aceptan tarjetas de crédito, por lo que conviene llevar algo de efectivo.
money.quote: Small businesses and family-run stores almost never accept credit cards, so it is useful to keep a moderate amount of cash on hand.

money.en: Most ATMs pay out a maximum of ₹10,000 per transaction.
money.es: La mayoría de los cajeros entrega un máximo de ₹10.000 por transacción.
money.quote: Most ATMs will pay out a maximum of ₹10,000 per transaction.

money.en: Tipping is unusual outside fancier restaurants, where up to 10% is appropriate.
money.es: Dar propina es poco habitual fuera de restaurantes elegantes, donde hasta un 10% es apropiado.
money.quote: tipping is unusual outside of fancier restaurants where up to 10% is appropriate.

money.en: It is good to carry small bills, as merchants and food stalls are notoriously short on change.
money.es: Conviene llevar billetes pequeños, pues comercios y puestos de comida casi nunca tienen cambio.
money.quote: It is always good to have a number of small bills on hand, as merchants and food stalls are notoriously short on change

money.en: Wikivoyage advises declining any offer of dynamic currency conversion (DCC).
money.es: Wikivoyage aconseja rechazar cualquier oferta de conversión dinámica de divisas (DCC).
money.quote: Decline any offer of dynamic currency conversion (DCC)

etiquette.en: Respect local dress code and customs, particularly at religious sites and in rural areas.
etiquette.es: Respeta el código de vestimenta y las costumbres locales, sobre todo en sitios religiosos y zonas rurales.
etiquette.quote: Respect local dress code and customs, particularly when visiting religious sites and rural areas.

etiquette.en: Take off your shoes when visiting a temple, mosque or someone's home.
etiquette.es: Quítate los zapatos al visitar un templo, una mezquita o una casa.
etiquette.quote: Take off your shoes when visiting a temple, mosque or someone's home.

etiquette.en: The left hand is considered unclean in both Hinduism and Islam.
etiquette.es: La mano izquierda se considera impura tanto en el hinduismo como en el islam.
etiquette.quote: The left hand is considered unclean in both Hinduism and Islam.

etiquette.en: The head is considered the holiest part of the body, so avoid touching people on the head.
etiquette.es: La cabeza se considera la parte más sagrada del cuerpo, así que evita tocar a las personas en la cabeza.
etiquette.quote: The head is considered to be the holiest part of the body, so avoid touching people on the head

etiquette.en: Outside larger cities, do not shake hands with someone of the opposite sex unless they extend their hand first.
etiquette.es: Fuera de las grandes ciudades, no estreches la mano a alguien del sexo opuesto salvo que extienda la mano primero.
etiquette.quote: it is advised that you do not shake hands with a person of the opposite sex unless the other person extends their hand first.

etiquette.en: Tank tops, miniskirts and other revealing or tight-fitting clothing can attract unwanted attention.
etiquette.es: Las camisetas sin mangas, minifaldas y otra ropa reveladora o ajustada pueden atraer atención no deseada.
etiquette.quote: Tank tops, miniskirts and other revealing or tight-fitting clothing can attract unwanted attention.

connectivity.en: Jio, Airtel, Vi and BSNL serve all of India, and Jio has the best coverage, with Airtel somewhat behind.
connectivity.es: Jio, Airtel, Vi y BSNL cubren toda India; Jio tiene la mejor cobertura y Airtel va algo detrás.
connectivity.quote: Jio has the best coverage throughout the country and Airtel is somewhat behind.

connectivity.en: Mobile stores generally refuse to sell SIM cards to anyone without an Aadhaar or local ID, including foreigners.
connectivity.es: Las tiendas móviles suelen negarse a vender SIM a quien no tenga Aadhaar o documento local, incluidos extranjeros.
connectivity.quote: Mobile stores generally refuse to sell SIM cards to anyone without an Aadhaar or local ID, including foreign nationals.

connectivity.en: Wikivoyage says all airports and railway stations offer free high speed Wi-Fi.
connectivity.es: Wikivoyage indica que todos los aeropuertos y estaciones de tren ofrecen wifi gratuito de alta velocidad.
connectivity.quote: All airports and railway stations offer free high speed Wi-Fi.

connectivity.en: Many free Wi-Fi services require a one-time password (OTP) sent to an Indian cell phone number.
connectivity.es: Muchos servicios de wifi gratuito exigen una contraseña de un solo uso enviada a un número móvil indio.
connectivity.quote: Many free Wi-Fi services will require entering a one-time password (OTP) sent to an Indian cell phone number

connectivity.en: In Jammu and Kashmir or Ladakh, prepaid SIMs from elsewhere in India lose network; only postpaid or locally bought tourist SIMs work.
connectivity.es: En Jammu y Cachemira o Ladakh, las SIM prepago de otras partes de India pierden red; solo funcionan las pospago o las SIM turísticas locales.
connectivity.quote: your phone will immediately lose network. Only postpaid SIMs or locally purchased tourist SIMs work here.

connectivity.en: The most important blocked sites for travellers are popular Chinese services like TikTok and WeChat.
connectivity.es: Los sitios bloqueados más importantes para viajeros son servicios chinos populares como TikTok y WeChat.
connectivity.quote: the most important sites that are blocked are popular Chinese services like TikTok and WeChat
